newsitem.title: USA: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.
newsitem.headline: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.

text.p: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls as of 0805 CDT.
LIVE CATTLE - Steady to off 0.200 cent. Lower boxed beef values and expected light packer demand for fed cattle.
FEEDER CATTLE - Off 0.100 to up 0.100 cent. Corn futures called higher but feeder index continues to rise.
LEAN HOGS - Off 0.100 to 0.200 cent. Lower cash hog indications and pork cutout values lower.
PORK BELLIES - Off 0.200 to 0.500 cent. Carryover pressure on weaker cash and fairly large hog slaughter.
